content.comment_body: On a related note, is it possible to configure one of the [product_name] [version_no] digital inputs to function as an analog input? I am looking for a setup with 1 analog input and 7 digital inputs.
Hello, Yes, you can use an analog amplifier as a reference for setting the counter ON value. Please refer to the provided image for clarification. Regards,

Hi, Whether the [product_name] [version_no] supports analog inputs depends on the specific [product_name] type. The models with AC power supply do not offer support for analog inputs, but those with DC power supply do. Common examples are [product_name] 12/24V RC ([article_no]) or RCE ([article_no]), both of which support up to 4 analog inputs (0 to 10V). In contrast, [product_name] 230V RC, RCo, or RCE do not include onboard analog input support. For further details, consult the technical data in the [product_name] manual or refer to [url]. Regardless of which [product_name] module you have, you can still connect dedicated analog expansion modules ([product_name] AM2). Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are discussing whether a digital input on [product_name] [version_no] modules can be reconfigured as an analog input. Responses clarify that this depends on the power supply and model specifications, notably distinguishing types with onboard analog input support. The discussion highlights the importance of clear documentation regarding input options for these modules.
